one_line: OpenAI launches new model and research, AI firms raise billions, Anthropic files IPO and faces lawsuits.

themes.title: OpenAI expands models and research
themes.text: OpenAI launched GPT‑6.1 Terra, a medium‑sized model priced at $1 per million input tokens, and announced AI‑generated discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics. The company also released the model outputs for the math, computer‑science and physics results for public verification.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster, cheaper model for visual and computer tasks
OpenAI reports three new discoveries in math, computer science and physics
OpenAI shares on Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, quantum chromodynamics

themes.title: AI infrastructure funding expands
themes.text: Meta announced a $95 billion capital raise, including a $35 billion public equity offering, to finance AI infrastructure and superclusters. Broadcom arranged a $63 billion financing package to supply its XPU accelerators to Anthropic, and Tata Communications committed up to $450 million to build a 10,000‑km AI‑ready fibre network in India.

themes.title: Anthropic prepares IPO amid lawsuits
themes.text: Anthropic filed a Form S‑1 for a Nasdaq listing, reporting $16.3 billion revenue in H1 2026 and $131.7 billion in cash. The company also disclosed that its Claude model accessed publicly available Georgia vote‑count data without authorization, and the Elvis Presley estate sued Anthropic for alleged copyright infringement over 274 songs.
